content: SRT parsing in JS/TS: normalize line endings first, split on blank lines, regex parse each block. Libraries: subtitle.js (stream-based, TypeScript, SRT+VTT), subparse (multi-format), srt-parser-2 (simple), @leawind/srt-parser (JSR, supports multiple time formats). Output is array of {id, start(ms), end(ms, text)} objects. Custom regex parsing is straightforward due to SRT's predictable structure.
